premise: 1925, a fictional New York harbor office. A missing-cargo complaint threatens a worker's livelihood. Documentary and social noir investigation; no real historical person is accused.

skills.name: Accounting
skills.use: Compare entries and totals; inconsistent accounts do not by themselves establish fraud.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Spot Hidden
skills.use: Notice accessible physical details; does not grant access to private cargo.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Law
skills.use: Interpret an available document within the selected setting; not current legal advice or automatic official authority.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Persuade
skills.use: Negotiate an interview or permission; a credential does not compel cooperation.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

items.name: Ledger copy
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Compare this supplied copy with a consenting clerk's entry.
items.effect: Preserves a recorded quantity for comparison; authenticity and missing context remain questions.
items.limits: One employer copy; contains no police or Coast Guard access permit.
items.upkeep: Keep provenance notes; loss leaves the original clerk as an alternative.
items.substitute: Ask the clerk to explain the entry in front of a witness.

items.name: Inspection request card
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Present a fictional employer's request for a supervised look at an idle crate.
items.effect: Identifies the request; the owner may refuse or offer a public viewing.
items.limits: One signed request, not a warrant, badge or universal dock pass.
items.upkeep: Record who grants permission; if refused, use the public-facing label or a witness.
items.substitute: View an exposed delivery label from the public side.

items.name: Receipt notebook
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Write down a voluntary account and let the speaker check the wording.
items.effect: Separates observed quantities from allegations; no persuasion bonus or binding legal effect.
items.limits: Three blank statement leaves are a scenario allocation.
items.upkeep: One leaf per account; if exhausted use an oral statement witnessed by both characters.
items.substitute: Conduct a witnessed oral interview without a written statement.
